posts.title: Notes from Production
posts.description: I'm probably deep in the AI echo chamber — I write software for a living and I'm building products that run on these models. But even knowing that, I'm surprised how far my day-to-day experience is from the average sentiment I see from other engineers, let alone people outside tech.
